name: Slow Water - Slow Water
plainLyrics:
Beyond the harbour wall
A heron waits without a sound
And far below the silver swell
The kelp forests slowly sway
A bell from some forgotten tide
Drifts softly over the flats
And all the shore is salt and slate and gold

No chart would lead us to the shore
No log records the how or when
Yet something turns and something stays
And learns to rise toward the sun

Sailors crossing on the quay
By luck two weathered faces meet
And you are mine and what you hold is true
And shall I carry you ashore
And row you past the reef
And help you mend the sail the best I can

No bell is ringing us away
No hand is pressing down the lids
No voice is raised and no oar is dipped
No gull is circling the mast

Windless every dusk you come
Across my sleeping hands
Inviting me to leave the dock
And past the shutters of the loft
Come drifting in on morning haze
A thousand small reflections of the harbour

And no one hums me down to sleep
And no one asks me where I have been
So I leave the lantern lit
Wave to you across the bay
